# The price checker's golden corpus (tests/test_pricecheck_golden.py): copied items as the game gives them
# (Ctrl+Alt+C unless the name says plain), each after a "=== name" line. Hand-written to cover every way an item is
# priced: bases, uniques, tablets, waystones, jewels, flasks / charms, gems, currency, runes, item flags, quality.
=== rare_ring

Rarity: Rare
Doom Grasp
Sapphire Ring
--------
Requires: Level 60
--------
Item Level: 82
--------
{ Implicit Modifier }

--------
{ Prefix Modifier "Prior's" (Tier: 3) — Life }
+95(85-99) to maximum Life
{ Prefix Modifier "Cobalt" (Tier: 4) — Mana }
+60(55-64) to maximum Mana
{ Suffix Modifier "of the Kaleidoscope" (Tier: 2) — Elemental, Fire, Resistance }
+32(31-35)% to Fire Resistance
{ Suffix Modifier "of Sirocco" (Tier: 5) — Elemental, Lightning, Resistance }
+22(21-25)% to Lightning Resistance
{ Suffix Modifier "of the Lynx" (Tier: 7) — Attribute }
+8(5-8) to Dexterity
